mapper.sql: id, menu_name AS name, parent_id AS parentId, menu_type AS menuType, permission_code AS permission, route_path AS path, component_key AS component, sort_order AS sortOrder, enabled, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu(menu_name, parent_id, menu_type, permission_code, route_path, component_key, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{entity.name}, #{entity.parentId}, #{entity.menuType}, #{entity.permission}, #{entity.path}, #{entity.component}, #{entity.sortOrder}, #{entity.enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET menu_name = #{entity.name}, parent_id = #{entity.parentId}, menu_type = #{entity.menuType}, permission_code = #{entity.permission}, route_path = #{entity.path}, component_key = #{entity.component}, sort_order = #{entity.sortOrder}, enabled = #{entity.enabled}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND version = #{entity.version}
